metadata.description: EU REACH Regulation relevant substances for fragrance

substances.name: Musk xylene

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Max 1% in fine fragrance, 0.4% in other cosmetics; vPvB substance

substances.notes: Very persistent, very bioaccumulative (vPvB); SVHC candidate list

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Max 1.4% in fine fragrance, 0.56% in other leave-on products

substances.name: D4 (Octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane)

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Restricted in wash-off cosmetic products >= 0.1%; PBT/vPvB substance

substances.notes: PBT/vPvB; SVHC candidate list; restricted under Entry 70

substances.name: D5 (Decamethylcyclopentasiloxane)

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Restricted in wash-off cosmetic products >= 0.1%; PBT/vPvB substance

substances.notes: PBT/vPvB; SVHC candidate list; restricted under Entry 70

substances.name: Methyl eugenol

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Max 0.01% in fine fragrance, 0.004% in eau de toilette, 0.002% in other leave-on; Annex III entry 25 of Cosmetics Regulation

substances.notes: CMR Cat 2 carcinogen; naturally present in many essential oils

substances.name: Atranol

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Banned in cosmetics; Annex II entry 1381 of Cosmetics Regulation

substances.notes: Extremely potent sensitizer; found in oakmoss and treemoss extracts

substances.name: Chloroatranol

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Banned in cosmetics; Annex II entry 1382 of Cosmetics Regulation

substances.notes: Extremely potent sensitizer; found in oakmoss and treemoss extracts

substances.name: HICC (Hydroxyisohexyl 3-cyclohexene carboxaldehyde / Lyral)

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Banned in cosmetics; Annex II entry 1383 of Cosmetics Regulation

substances.notes: Strong sensitizer; reproductive toxicant candidate; formerly widely used in fragrance

substances.name: Methylisothiazolinone (MIT)

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Max 15 ppm in rinse-off products only; banned in leave-on cosmetics since 2017

substances.notes: Potent sensitizer; preservative; not a fragrance ingredient but relevant to formulated products

substances.name: Cinnamal (Cinnamaldehyde)

annex_xvii_restriction.notes: Annex III allergen; must be declared on label when above 10 ppm in leave-on or 100 ppm in rinse-off products

substances.notes: EU regulated allergen; strong sensitizer; REACH registered
